_comment: Human-verified fallback times, used ONLY when the live API and the previous snapshot both return nothing for a stop. The live API always wins when it has data.
_why: Passio intermittently drops a stop's schedule. First Avenue At 17th Street (Route E) is the Stuytown drop-off for the trip home, so losing it silently would break the homeward direction entirely.
_verifiedFrom: passiogo.com schedule=4 and eta=3 responses, cross-checked between both endpoints
